test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: ‘ZXCV’ is related to ‘XWDX’ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, ‘POIU’ is related to ‘NNJW’. Then 'LKJH' is related to...?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘ZXCV’ is related to ‘XWDX’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbe6128379fd31a16c2ba93c6d295e615ba7a2c112a7231493cb11a80139db00.png] 

‘POIU’ is related to ‘NNJW’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f92f476cf2940259322a99a0e0d4ac8e6d4934379ff2e9dcc7e5d4dbdb13f1d0.png] 

Similarly, 'LKJH' is related to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38d5d042e06922b501f1d5c73a05e3c2ca9a9bd4345ff2e01717720f9080c707.png] 

Hence,** 'option 4'** is the correct answer.
